finding.description: A new, simple ring with a stone suddenly materializes in the woman's left hand, resting on top of the original studded ring she was holding.

The right hand moves downwards holding tweezers, and a moment later returns holding a completely different thin metal pin tool. There is no visible action or sufficient time to explain the dropping of the tweezers and picking up of the new tool.

verdicts.reason: At 00:04, as the left hand rotates slightly, a new ring with a prominent stone spontaneously materializes on top of the studded ring she is already holding. It does not enter the frame from elsewhere but simply appears in her hand.

The right hand, which was holding tweezers, lowers briefly and immediately returns holding a completely different pin-like tool. The continuous motion and lack of a scene cut indicate this is an AI generation continuity error rather than a realistic tool swap.
